email.body1:
Nikki, saw Aurora tripled its driverless network to 10 routes and is pushing across the Sun Belt toward 200 trucks this year.

Expanding lanes that fast usually means more carriers and shippers in play than business development can personally cover before the next route goes live, and that is where good accounts go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Aurora off your expansion and hiring signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to cover the new lanes
email.body2:
Nikki, quick follow-up for Aurora.

As the route map grows, the target list grows with it, but the team that has to touch every shipper does not. Most BD orgs cannot see how many meetings they need each quarter to actually cover the new geography, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Aurora needs to cover the new lanes this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Nikki, last bit of proof for Aurora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Aurora's reply rate likely compares to other expanding tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nikki, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding BD headcount is not a priority while you stand up the new routes, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a national expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a logistics motion? I will tailor it to Aurora either way.
